name: Adobe Creative Cloud Pro for students
summary: Discounted access to Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and 20+ other Adobe apps.
key: A$23.99 a month for the first year, then A$63.99 a month (annual plan billed monthly, incl. GST).
how: Choose the student and teacher plan on Adobe's page and verify your student status.
catches: It's an annual plan billed monthly. Read Adobe's offer terms before you sign up.
Adobe may ask for proof after purchase. Outside North America you have six days to send it.
After you graduate, education pricing continues for one year.
who: Students aged 13 or over at an accredited university or college that grants degrees needing at least two years of full-time study.
need: A school email for instant verification, or a dated document such as a student ID or fee statement.
open_questions: Whether the first-year price is limited to first-time members isn't stated on the pages checked.
